items.title: Vertiv and Ballard announce strategic technology partnership to support alternative energy usage for data centers in North America and EMEA
items.summary: Vertiv (NYSE: VRT), a global provider of critical digital infrastructure and continuity solutions, and PEM fuel cell market leader, Ballard Power Systems (NASDAQ: BLDP; TSX: BLDP), have entered into a strategic technology partnership with a focus on backup power applications for data centres and critical infrastructures, scalable from 200kW to multiple MWs.

items.title: Vertiv to Open Software Center at Centerra in Loveland, Colo.
items.summary: Vertiv, a leader in critical infrastructure for data centers, communication networks and commercial and industrial facilities, will open a software and data analytics center of excellence at Centerra in Loveland, Colo. The center, which will employ 100 data scientists, software developers and other professionals, is slated to open in August and will help Vertiv better serve customers globally and provide a hub for customers on the West Coast.

items.title: Geist Delivers Future-Proof Data Center Power Management with Next Generation Rack Power Distribution Unit (PDU) Platform
items.summary: Geist, a division of Vertiv and provider of intelligent power and management solutions for data centers, today announced the release of Geist GU2, its highly anticipated next generation of upgradeable rack PDUs. The Geist GU2 family establishes a robust power infrastructure foundation for mission-critical facilities and introduces an evolutionary design platform that simplifies upgrades to technology advances as business needs evolve. Geist GU2 is available immediately in all regions where Geist products are sold.

items.title: Vertiv Achieves Three Industry-leading Awards from Frost & Sullivan
items.summary: Vertiv (NYSE: VRT), a global provider of critical digital infrastructure and continuity solutions, has received three industry leadership awards from Frost & Sullivan, with recognition in EMEA for product leadership in the prefabricated modular (PFM) data center industry, and for competitive strategy and customer value leadership in the Asia-Pacific critical power industry.

items.title: Vertiv Expands its Portfolio of Infrastructure Solutions Wholesalers in México
